name: Signature
definition: Additional security provision attached to a contract. A (numeric) signature can be used as evidence of origin and integrity, i.e., authenticity of the signed data. A judge can accept this evidence as proof.

Conditions.name: Conditions
Conditions.definition: Parameters related to the signature provided.

CardPaymentValidation.name: Card Payment Validation
CardPaymentValidation.definition: Validation of a payment by card for which a signeture is specified.
